description: Primary outcomes of published trials that report no VASI threshold, taken from the published abstract because the full text is not fetchable. These rows are deliberately kept out of curation/topline-results.json, which is frozen by hash because the v0.4 and v0.5 models and the evidence ranking are defined by it. Nothing here feeds a model: the instrument is not VASI, so the model's instrument filter excludes these rows in any case.

results.source: HI-Light Vitiligo Trial, Br J Dermatol 2021 (PMID 33006767); HTA 24(64) (PMID 33245043)
results.note: Counts as printed in the abstract, not derived from a percentage. The full text could not be fetched: the NIHR library, the institutional repository and Europe PMC's book page all answer a bot check, so no table cell was verified. Randomised group size 173; 54 of that arm were missing at the primary endpoint, so the assumption-free bound is 11.6% to 42.8%. The trial's own primary analysis used multiple imputation and reported an adjusted difference for combination versus TCS of 10.9% (95% CI 1.0-20.9, p=0.032, NNT 10).
